name: window-sidecar-listen-refused
description: The host refuses the registration of the session tab-refused of the sidecar @x/refused, and the page rejects the listener with the refusal.
reason: The case records a refusal that the host gives for a registration the producer cannot make refused on demand: the case states the reply without a declared sidecar state that the producer builds (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#limits).
